events.title: ETH AI Center Researchers Community Meetup
events.venue: ETH AI Center, OAT X 11, Oerlikon
events.blurb: Recurring meetup series for the AI research community at ETH Zurich.

events.title: Energ-IACK — Hackathon IA & énergie
events.blurb: First edition of Geneva’s two-day AI and energy hackathon on the theme « Dessine-moi un NetZéro », where teams work on energy-transition challenges; the projects then present their results at the energIA conference on 1 December.

events.title: Coffee & Prompt #011
events.blurb: The Geneva builders’ weekend coworking morning: bring an AI project or side hustle, work alongside others, and optionally show a feature or a lesson learned for feedback from the room.

events.title: Hype vs. Shipped: What AI Really Changes in Product Work
events.blurb: Two talks on what AI has actually changed in building products: Coople on a year spent replacing squads, sprints and story points with AI-first workflows and smaller teams, including the experiments that failed, and Brack.Alltron on where AI earned its place and why plain analytics sometimes still beats machine learning.

events.title: Swiss AI Summit 2026
events.cost: CHF 790 Executive Pass / CHF 950 standard (excl. VAT)
events.blurb: Full-day summit at the Kunsthaus for senior business, technology and government leaders, spanning finance and insurance, government and defence, manufacturing, cybersecurity, quantum and healthcare — with speakers from Microsoft Switzerland, IBM, Nestlé, ABB, HSBC and the Canton of Zurich, plus workshops, demos and a one-to-one meeting platform.

events.title: AI in azienda: AI sotto controllo
events.venue: Campus Est USI-SUPSI, Blocco C, Aula C1.02, Via la Santa 1, Viganello
events.blurb: Closing evening of the Ticino series on conscious AI use in business, this one on data, responsibility, rules and governance — content, a hands-on workshop and networking, capped at thirty participants.

events.title: AI Observability Switzerland — Giving Your AI Systems the Visibility They Deserve
events.organiser: Swiss Digital Network (Effective SRE & DevOps Community) with Grafana Labs
events.blurb: An hour for engineering, platform and data teams on tracking down rising token costs, stuck agent chains and slower model responses — monitoring LLM calls without custom instrumentation, tracing agent chains with OpenTelemetry, and setting up continuous evaluation to catch quality drops.

events.title: Applied AI Journal Club Bern #10
events.blurb: Monthly reading group in Bern where the group works through one applied-AI article together, with time afterwards for open exchange; the paper is shared in advance.

events.title: AWS Swiss User Group Geneva #30: Kiro Nights
events.blurb: A beginner-friendly hands-on evening building a working web app from scratch with Kiro, AWS's agentic IDE, with the organisers on hand to help — bring a laptop, pizza and apéro included.

events.title: Cloud Native Computing Meetup — November 2026
events.blurb: Three talks and an apéro: the guardrails Open Systems put in place before letting an AI agent work on its Kubernetes clusters, a Rust-based zero-dependency etcd replacement with the QuantyKube sandbox, and a session on Jellyfin.

events.title: Building a Multi-AZ Cloud in Switzerland & Embedding Quality in Agile Delivery
events.blurb: The group’s last evening of 2026: Hidora on building a highly available multi-availability-zone cloud in Switzerland on Kubernetes, and a talk on defining quality processes across several teams in scrum-of-scrums delivery.

events.title: Digital Series #13 — Moins d’administratif grâce à l’IA
events.venue: Co-working La Bergerie, Place du Midi 50
events.organiser: Swiss Digital Center / Fondation The Ark (with CCI Valais)
events.blurb: Valais SMEs see how AI agents can take over routine admin — client requests, bookings, contracts and follow-up — with a live tool demo and a local case study from the Sion coworking space.

events.title: Boosting Life Sciences Innovation with AI
events.blurb: Lunchtime session with the Wyss Center AI Hub, SOPHiA GENETICS, the Swiss Data Science Center and BrainQuant on the data, infrastructure, validation and regulatory groundwork behind AI in research partnerships, precision medicine and digital biomarkers.

events.title: The Glass Box Roadshow — Executive Track Zurich
events.blurb: An evening counterpart to the roadshow for leaders accountable for AI returns: a keynote from someone who has already rolled AI out in their company, a live demonstration and a closed-door roundtable.

events.title: The Glass Box Roadshow — Zurich
events.blurb: Make’s Zurich stop on where AI automation already works and where it does not: live demos, a product roadmap session, an open panel and lunch, aimed at operations, IT and transformation leads scaling automation across teams.

events.title: Growing Together Conference GTC26
events.venue: The Circle Convention Center, The Circle 27
events.blurb: A full day for business and data leaders on getting AI past isolated use cases and into scalable capability — keynotes from Benedict Evans and Google Cloud’s Alon Halevy, leader tracks with Helvetia, Axpo and Emmi, plus tech talks and workshops.

events.title: SAIC #041: AI in Healthcare & Pharma — From Breakthrough Technology to Better Patient Outcomes
events.venue: Maison Internationale des Associations, Rue des Savoises 15
events.cost: CHF 5 in person (50 places) / free online livestream
events.blurb: Dr Stamen Popov on where AI already adds value from drug discovery to patient support, and where trust, ethics, regulation and adoption still get in the way of better outcomes.

events.title: AI in Production: Introduction to MLOps — Training at EPFL
events.cost: CHF 1,000 (10% off for EPFL alumni and SDSC partners)
events.blurb: One-day SDSC training on designing, deploying and operating ML systems at scale — version control, CI/CD, experiment tracking, monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining. Registration closes 24 September.

events.title: Sovereign AI Night by Giotto
events.blurb: Launch evening for Giotto Alto and Solo: meet the team, try the models, watch a Giotto Workstation demo and argue about what sovereignty in AI actually requires — with pizza, drinks and live music.

events.title: Satellite Event: From Data to Decisions — AI in Asset Management
events.blurb: A Swiss AI Summit satellite session on how asset managers turn increasingly complex data into usable investment insight, and where AI makes a genuine difference rather than noise.

events.title: Satellite Event: From Smart AI to Better Work
events.blurb: An interactive executive lab run with Zeix on redesigning work around AI: deciding what the machine should actually do, and marking out where human judgement, responsibility and control have to stay.

events.title: AI Safety Weekly: Alignment from Token Zero
events.venue: ETH Main Building, HG D3.3, Rämistrasse 101
events.blurb: V. Moskvoretskii (EPFL) on building an assistant persona into pretraining rather than bolting alignment on afterwards — a technique now part of training Apertus 2, Switzerland’s open model. Moderate technical background assumed.

events.title: Lunch & Learn: Chat mit GPT — Prompting für Anfänger und Profis
events.blurb: A 45-minute lunchtime session with AI lecturer Christian Sidow on getting more out of ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude — the difference between chatbots, assistants and agents, how to write a prompt that works, and how to make a model check its own output.

events.title: Brown Bag: Copilot erfolgreich einführen — KI-Power im Büroalltag
events.organiser: InnovationsBiotop Uri with Business Help Point
events.cost: Free (optional lunch CHF 9; registration by 16 November)
events.blurb: A German-language lunch hour on the organisational side of Microsoft 365 Copilot rather than prompt tricks: Roman Schön on why AI initiatives stall, why structure and context beat perfectly worded prompts, and what it takes to make the tool stick in day-to-day office work.

events.title: DINAcon 2026
events.blurb: Switzerland’s conference on digital sustainability — 36 sessions on open source, open data, digital sovereignty, data protection and copyright, with 250+ attendees and a closing Hacknight.

events.title: Agentic Nights #1 — Identity, Software Factories & Agent Memory
events.blurb: First evening of Global AI Zürich’s new agentic series, with three talks on real agent implementations covering identity, software factories and agent memory.

events.title: The 4th Innovation Debate: AI for All?
events.venue: Westhive, Bâtiment Alto, Esplanade de Pont-Rouge 9A
events.organiser: Geneva Innovation Movement and Geneva Research Lab for Digital Impact, with UNICEF Digital Impact Division and the University of Geneva
events.blurb: An Oxford-style debate on the motion “access to AI is worth the dependency it creates”, with four debaters, a jury of Geneva politicians and an audience vote, followed by a networking apéritif.

events.title: Conférence Next — Design x IA
events.venue: QG Center, Route de la Chaux 4 (QoQa)
events.blurb: An afternoon on what AI has actually changed in design work: a study of how 100 designers use it, prototyping with AI agents directly against a codebase, and how Swissquote rebuilt its design system with AI — then networking drinks.

events.title: Digital Economy Award 2026
events.organiser: Swiss Digital Economy Award AG with digitalswitzerland
events.blurb: Switzerland’s digital-economy awards at the Hallenstadion: an Executive Afternoon of nine partner-hosted sessions on AI, customer relationships, skills and stablecoins, followed by the Award Night for categories from Pioneer of the Year to NextGen Hero.

events.title: AI Risks in CyberSecurity
events.venue: Novotel Genève Centre, Rue de Zurich 19
events.blurb: Afternoon session in Geneva on how organisations can keep using AI internally without taking on unmanaged risk, with presentations followed by a networking reception; CPE credits available via ISC2 and ISACA.

events.title: AI Safety: Open Meet Up
events.cost: Free (registration required, food and drinks provided)
events.blurb: An evening with no fixed programme in place of the usual weekly session: meet the organisers, ask how the AI safety field is put together, or pick up a thread from an earlier talk — newcomers as welcome as people already working on it.

events.title: Agentic Engineering Days Zurich 2026
events.blurb: A one-day engineering conference on AI coding and agent systems: 38+ sessions across four tracks — using AI tools, building AI-powered systems, sponsor spotlights and hands-on workshops — with speakers from OpenAI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA, Google and AWS.

events.title: AI Breakfast #56 Luzern
events.blurb: Merun Gugelmann of Aeberli Treuhand on how an 80-year-old trust company got from Microsoft Teams to building its own Azure applications — the steps of that digitisation journey, concrete examples, and the setup on Azure App Services.

events.title: AI Society — AI Coffee Chats Zurich (20 November)
events.blurb: Fortnightly drop-in coffee hour for anyone working with AI in Zurich: no presentations, just questions, demos and shop talk over an hour.

events.title: Data Science Final Project Presentations
events.blurb: Open evening where data science students present their end-to-end projects, from data collection and analysis through modelling to visualisation, followed by questions and networking.

events.title: Basel AI & Vibe Coding Club — First Meetup
events.blurb: Kick-off meetup for a new Basel group around AI-assisted coding: short intros, side-project show-and-tell, and an open round on what people want to build next.

events.title: STEM4Health Hackathon
events.venue: ETH Zürich Campus Hönggerberg, HPH building
events.organiser: Johnson & Johnson Switzerland / Swiss Data Science Center
events.blurb: A hundred students and early-career researchers spend a weekend on real pharmaceutical manufacturing problems, combining manufacturing data, mechanistic modelling and machine learning with industry and academic mentors before pitching to a jury.

events.title: AI Tinkerers Lausanne — November 2026 Meetup
events.organiser: AI Tinkerers Lausanne, hosted at the Unlimitrust Campus
events.blurb: A demo-first evening for people actually building with AI: around half a dozen five-minute demos of work in progress, each followed by questions — slides and pitch decks are explicitly not allowed — then pizza and networking.

events.title: Basel Data Science & AI Meetup — November 2026
events.blurb: Three practical talks on getting machine learning and AI models deployed and running in production, followed by networking with the Basel data community.

events.title: AI Safety: Building Trustworthy AI in the Real World
events.organiser: Elevate Tech: Women and Minorities in AI, Tech, and Science
events.blurb: Four speakers from Google, AWS, Unique and Systematic-X on keeping AI systems trustworthy once they act on their own — how to evaluate and monitor before and after deployment, where guardrails, human oversight and red-teaming fit, and how to ship fast without losing accountability.

events.title: Apertus Claritas: An Inside View of Switzerland’s Open Model
events.venue: ETH AI Center Foyer, OAT X 11, Andreasstrasse 5, Oerlikon
events.blurb: Lightning talks from the interpretability and safety hub built around Apertus, Switzerland’s open multilingual model: shared representations across languages, emergent misalignment from stereotypes that pass moderation, probes that catch repetition loops early, and persona binding formed in pre-training.

events.title: Built with Lovable · Lausanne #2
events.cost: Free (host approval required; Lovable credits included)
events.blurb: A 90-minute hands-on build where everyone ships a working web app with AI features using Lovable’s built-in models — no API keys or separate accounts — with mentors on hand, then demos and drinks. Bring a laptop and an idea.

events.title: KI-Agenten & -Work: Skills und Anbindungen für konkrete Entlastung im Alltag
events.blurb: A full German-language day with Michael Kyburz on getting AI to take over recurring work: three base skills, how to build your own, and wiring assistants into calendar, mail and project tools so multi-step workflows run with clear checkpoints for human review. Fifteen places, and a paid ChatGPT or Claude subscription is required.

events.title: AI Safety Weekly: Finding Your Way Into AI Safety
events.venue: ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, room HG D3.3
events.blurb: A map of the routes into AI safety and governance work — fellowships, research programmes, who is eligible, when they open and how they are funded — with people who have been through them answering questions. No particular background needed.

events.title: Visualizing Peace Indicators by Interactive Things
events.blurb: Designers and developers from Interactive Things walk through how they turned qualitative peace indicators from around the world into a comparable visual dataset.

events.title: DemystifAI 01 — Homebrewed
events.venue: Maison de la Femme, Avenue de l’Eglantine 6
events.blurb: Kouros, who is not a developer and has a full-time job, explains how he used AI to build a custom ERP for the La Nébuleuse brewery, followed by guided discussion, audience questions and an apéro.

events.title: The Geneva AI Conference 2026
events.blurb: An evening on enterprise AI strategy and returns, opened by Geneva city executive councillor Joëlle Bertossa and built around a panel with IBM, SAP, Hostelworld and Executive AI. The venue is still to be confirmed.

events.title: L’impresa potenziata con AI
events.blurb: An Italian-language afternoon in Chiasso built on real cases and measured numbers rather than promises: AI agents in the business, sovereign data, and what institutions are for — closing with a networking apéro.

events.title: Kongress «KI im Energiesektor»
events.blurb: Day-long congress bringing around 150 specialists from energy, technology and policy together on where AI and data create real value in grids, buildings and districts, with a keynote by Gerard Reid of Alexa Capital.

events.title: Mindstone Geneva November AI Meetup
events.venue: L’Annexe by Rentes Genevoises, Rue du Port 3
events.blurb: Monthly Geneva AI evening with three practical talks — building with LLMs, working faster with AI and where it is all heading — then pizza and networking. Forty places.

events.title: Real or Generated? | SAIC x The Founders Club
events.organiser: Switzerland AI Community with The Founders Club
events.blurb: Playful challenges to tell real images, sounds and text apart from AI-generated ones, with curated visuals, music and networking across Geneva's tech, creative and founder communities.

events.title: Bessere Ergebnisse mit generativer KI: Advanced Prompting für die öffentliche Verwaltung
events.blurb: A German-language follow-on course for public-sector staff who already use generative AI daily: controlling output more precisely, building reusable prompt templates, and setting up your own CustomGPT or Copilot agent against your own use cases.

events.title: Zurich Pre-NeurIPS 2026 Poster Session
events.venue: ETH AI Center, OAT X 11, Oerlikon
events.organiser: ETH AI Center / Zurich ELLIS Unit
events.blurb: Zurich’s official pre-conference poster session ahead of NeurIPS 2026, where researchers from across the city show accepted papers and other peer-reviewed work and meet the rest of the local AI community.

events.title: Writing The Living Organization — What AI Is Doing to How We Organize
events.blurb: Breeze Dong on the operating model behind her book The Living Organization, and an open discussion of what happens to teams, roles and decision-making when AI agents join the work.

events.title: Chalet Azure Romandie #17 — Talents Microsoft & Azure Local
events.blurb: A French-language Azure evening in Geneva: what AI has really changed about Microsoft recruitment and how candidates stay visible, then Azure Local for running Azure services inside a sovereign private cloud, with a live Foundry Local demo — quiz and networking afterwards.

events.title: Cloud Native Bern Meetup — November 2026
events.blurb: Two talks and an apéro hosted by Puzzle: wiring Amazon RDS to TimescaleDB with foreign data wrappers for federated Postgres on EKS — and where 10 TB starts to break it — then PostFinance on moving cloud and AI cost awareness earlier, and what AI cost governance takes.

events.title: HSG Fintech Summit 2026
events.cost: Not listed (separate ticket categories for HSG alumni, faculty and students)
events.blurb: The University of St.Gallen’s fintech day, themed this year on what AI does to finance: keynotes on AI in financial intermediation and asset management, research talks on model collapse, AI errors and moral hazard, a panel on AI’s effect on markets, and a closing apéro.

events.title: Robot Learning Paper Club — The World Model Edition
events.blurb: Short talks and paper walkthroughs on learned world models for robotics — action-conditioned video prediction, joint observation and action models, planning and policy evaluation, and synthetic data generation.

events.title: TAIC: AI Agents Need Permissions, Not Forgiveness
events.organiser: TAIC – Trustworthy AI Circle (ZHAW Centre for Artificial Intelligence)
events.blurb: Evening session on how far AI agents should be allowed to act on our behalf, with Maria Fay (SAP, University of Münster) and Matthias Plattner (Julius Bär) on AI governance across industries and whose values an agent should carry.

events.title: Kamikaze-KI-Keynote: KI baut live eine WordPress-Seite
events.blurb: Stefan Gilgen runs a live, unrehearsed experiment in which several AI models write the text, generate the images and assemble a complete website on stage, with a candid look at which models he uses day to day and what breaks along the way.

events.title: AI Futures: What's the Plan?
events.venue: ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, Room F 26.5
events.blurb: Fourth session of the AI Futures series, turning from the risks to the responses: technical safety work such as alignment, control, interpretability and evaluations; governance and policy including compute rules and treaties; and socio-structural preparedness — with the organisers’ own read on what looks most promising.

events.title: After Microsoft Ignite Special 2026
events.organiser: Swiss Microsoft Community (Microsoft Cloud Security & Modern Work)
events.blurb: Swiss MVPs recap the announcements from Microsoft Ignite 2026 in short sessions on Cloud & AI, the agent platform, Copilot and Microsoft IQ, security, data security and compliance, and agentic business applications, with an apéro after.

events.title: AI Agent Sandbox: Bring Your Ideas, Let's Explore Together!
events.blurb: An in-person working session where the group picks one AI agent idea from the room and explores it together with sticky notes, sketches and a timer — open to beginners and active builders alike.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Zurich
events.blurb: The on-site leg of the national Apertus hackathon: build on the open Apertus 8B model, strengthen its multilingual abilities and ship applications for private- and public-sector problems, with everything released as Open Commons.

events.title: AI Insights for Chief Executives
events.venue: Swiss AI Tower, ETH Zürich, Andreasstrasse 5
events.blurb: Executive workshop for CEOs, CFOs, CDOs and CTOs on turning data and AI into measurable business value, with case studies from EKZ, Merck and Richemont. Limited seats.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Zurich Finals
events.venue: AI Startup Center, Technopark Zürich, Technoparkstrasse 1
events.blurb: The public closing evening of the Zurich leg of Hack Apertus: the six best teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, local partner introductions and an award ceremony.

events.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich
events.venue: ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60
events.cost: Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included)
events.blurb: A deliberately small room of founders and executives comparing how they actually use AI: an invited talk, then group conversations on what worked, what failed and what they are trying next, followed by open networking.

events.title: Azure Zurich AI Infrastructure Night
events.blurb: In-person evening at Digicomp on the infrastructure side of running AI workloads on Azure.

events.title: Databricks Executive Roundtable — Data + AI World Tour Zurich
events.cost: Not listed (Executive Program pass, apply to attend)
events.blurb: An invitation-based dinner and discussion for data and technology executives the evening before the Data + AI World Tour, with a welcome from Databricks leadership and a Swiss customer segment; sessions and speakers are still to be announced.

events.title: AIristoteles 4.0 — Bis dass der Strom uns scheidet
events.organiser: HSLU Institut für Kommunikation und Marketing (IKM)
events.blurb: Fourth edition of HSLU’s AIristoteles series: an EPFL evolutionary psychologist and a psychotherapist discuss what it means when people enter long-term relationships with AI bots, moderated by Stephan Klapproth and followed by an apéro.

events.title: AWS Swiss User Group Bern — December Meetup
events.blurb: Final Bern meetup of the year for the Swiss AWS community: a mix of community talks plus discussion and networking, with the agenda announced closer to the date.

events.title: Databricks Data + AI World Tour Zurich 2026
events.blurb: Databricks' flagship Swiss stop on the Data + AI World Tour: keynotes, breakout sessions and hands-on training on Genie and Lakebase, plus an expo, with speakers from Databricks and Zurich Insurance.

events.title: energIA 2026 — IA & décarbonation
events.blurb: Second edition of the Geneva conference on AI and the energy transition, debating whether AI genuinely helps reach net zero by 2050 or mostly adds resource consumption and rebound effects, with public, private and academic participants and the Energ-IACK hackathon projects presenting their results.

events.title: Reshaping Information Research with AI
events.blurb: Two-hour on-site workshop from the EPFL Library comparing four AI-powered research assistants, how they work and where they differ from traditional information retrieval. Open to the public, registration required.

events.title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich — Final Edition
events.blurb: The closing session of IBM's 2026 hybrid series on IBM Bob, its AI development assistant — coding live alongside other European cities, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks covering everything from first idea to modernising legacy applications.

events.title: KI-Strategie und -Governance für KMUs
events.blurb: A 90-minute German-language session for SME decision-makers on steering generative AI use rather than letting it spread: setting a strategic frame, drafting an internal AI policy, weighing data-protection, liability and wrong-output risks, and planning a safe rollout under Swiss data protection law and the EU AI Act. Fifteen places.

events.title: TechTalk #30 @ Nine — What Tools Won’t Do for You
events.blurb: Build-and-deploy evening at Nine: nxt Engineering on how not to wreck an Azure migration, and Access for all on why manual accessibility testing still matters alongside automated and AI-assisted checks. Also livestreamed.

events.title: Ein Team, ein Plan und viele Agenten
events.blurb: A German-language breakfast session with Quatico CEO Jan Wloka on why adding more AI agents tends to produce more review work than finished work, and the three changes that fixed it for his team: a written decision before any agent starts coding, work split into packages that run in parallel, and one daily overview of what needs a human. Aimed at product owners and delivery leads, with a real work package run live.

events.title: Lunch & Learn: KI-Hype bei KMU? Erstmal tief durchatmen!
events.blurb: Management consultant Janet Dubé on what a small or mid-sized company actually needs in place before AI pays off — which processes and data basics matter, where the quick wins are, and which early mistakes to skip.

events.title: PTO IR: The Compiler Should Place Your NPU Barriers
events.venue: ETH Zurich, CAB building, Room G51, Universitätstrasse 6
events.blurb: Giacomo Castiglioni of Huawei’s Computing Systems Lab on compiling for asynchronous execution units on Ascend NPUs, with a scheme that lets the compiler insert and verify synchronisation for Gated DeltaNet and FlashAttention kernels.

events.title: 40 ans d’informatique en Valais — Conférence #3 : l’ERP, colonne vertébrale de l’entreprise, à l’ère de l’IA
events.venue: Campus Bellevue, Rte de la Plaine 2
events.organiser: HES-SO Valais-Wallis (Haute École de Gestion & Tourisme, filière Informatique de gestion)
events.blurb: Public French-language conference closing the 40th-anniversary series of the Valais computer-science school: Prof. Sébastien Gard on how SAP, Odoo and other ERP systems connect business functions and are changing with cloud and AI, plus braintec CEO Philipp Fux on digital transformation, followed by an apéritif.

events.title: KI-Update x swissAI Meetup — Die Auswirkungen der KI auf Kinder
events.blurb: Free German-language evening in Gebenstorf: a current AI update from Michael Kyburz, then Alexander Repenning on what AI means for children, closing with an apéro with the swissAI community.

events.title: Robotics Garage Night
events.blurb: Show-and-tell evening for people building robots: short demos of works in progress, honest accounts of what broke, then food and conversation.

events.title: Swiss IT Minds 2026 — IT, AI & Cyber Security
events.cost: Not listed (complimentary participation for qualified attendees)
events.blurb: Two days for Swiss IT and data leaders at the Dolder Grand on enterprise AI as a strategic capability, centralised versus decentralised AI governance in large organisations, securing AI agents as a hybrid workforce, and the governance basics behind all of it.

events.title: A4Q AI Foundation — Zertifizierungskurs
events.organiser: Obvious Works GmbH with Shajan Academy
events.blurb: A two-day German-language course leading to the A4Q AI Foundation certificate, covering how AI and machine learning systems work, where they fit in a business, and the risks and limits that come with them.

events.title: AI Forum Zürisee: Was ein Agent im Arbeitsalltag erledigt
events.blurb: A live look at an agentic setup that has been in daily office use for months: the agent prepares a project kick-off from a single instruction, turns a correction into a standing rule, and flags an email carrying a hidden instruction.

events.title: AI Made in Europe: Built Here. Scaled Everywhere.
events.organiser: The Founder's Story, a Google Cloud series
events.blurb: The season finale of Google Cloud's Founder's Story series: a panel on whether Europe can build its own global AI companies or will mostly buy AI from elsewhere, covering research, open models, compute, sovereignty and capital, followed by a networking apéro at Google's Europaallee office.

events.title: dbt Meetup Zurich
events.blurb: Evening for the Zürich dbt community aimed at analytics engineers, data engineers and data leaders, opening with Massimo Turola of Bank Vontobel on using dbt to manage Snowflake Cortex AI applications in an AI data catalog, then an apéro.

events.title: Business mit KI. Heute, nicht 2030. Vol. 02 — Führung ist kein Prompt
events.blurb: Second volume of the Lucerne series for entrepreneurs and C-level leaders on how AI reshapes teams, leadership and the job market: two short talks, a moderated panel and an apéro, capped at 50 guests and held in German.

events.title: Geneva 3D — Building a Living 3D Model of a Canton with AI Agents and Open Data
events.venue: Tesla showroom, Rue de la Confédération 8
events.organiser: Switzerland AI Community with Romandy CTO, hosted by Tesla
events.blurb: Arnaud Ricci on how he built Genève 3D, a browser-based 3D model of the whole canton, using AI agents and open data — with a live demonstration, questions from the room and a non-alcoholic apéro. The talk is in French with English subtitles.

events.title: IA : puissance ou prudence ?
events.organiser: Alp ICT, as part of the City of Geneva’s Semaine du climat 2026
events.blurb: A French-language citizen debate in Oxford style on the opportunities and risks of artificial intelligence: two teams coached by specialists argue before a jury of Geneva politicians, followed by an open discussion for SMEs and the public and an apéritif.

events.title: Unleashing the Power of MariaDB
events.venue: Swissquote Bank SA, Chem. de la Crétaux 33
events.organiser: MariaDB Swiss Group, with Swissquote and dbi services
events.blurb: An evening for database practitioners hosted by Swissquote: live demos and case studies on database modernisation, high availability with MaxScale, an Oracle-to-Galera migration, and pairing real-time payment workflows with in-memory caching and vector search for AI.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Überblick über moderne KI-Modelle
events.cost: CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members
events.blurb: German-language webinar by Christoph Bräunlich, Head of AI at BSI Software, mapping today's model landscape — LLMs, multimodal models, RAG and AI agents — plus the differences between closed, open-weights and open-source models.

events.title: Workplace & Security Ninja User Group Switzerland 2612
events.organiser: Workplace & Security Ninja User Group Switzerland
events.blurb: Full day of community sessions on Microsoft endpoint, identity and security work, including securing agent identities, privileged-access strategy with Entra and Intune, secure low-code on the Power Platform, and label engineering.

events.title: AI Society — AI Coffee Chats Zurich (4 December)
events.blurb: Fortnightly drop-in coffee hour for Zurich's AI practitioners: bring a question or a workflow to show, stay for as much of the hour as you like.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Onsite Hackathon Basel
events.blurb: The Basel leg of the national Apertus hackathon series, building applications and multilingual improvements on Switzerland’s open Apertus model at FHNW Campus Dreispitz, with everything produced released for reuse.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Basel Finals
events.blurb: The public closing evening of the Basel leg of Hack Apertus: the top teams pitch prototypes built on Switzerland’s open Apertus model, with a fireside chat with Phoeniqs, partner introductions from BaselTech, FHNW and ICT Scouts, and the award ceremony.

events.title: Christmas Special Hackathon — Operation Silent Night
events.blurb: Festive team hackathon where the Zurich Databricks User Group turns a sabotage mystery into hands-on practice with Genie, Lakebase and Databricks Apps.

events.title: AI-Stammtisch | Buchs
events.venue: OST Campus Buchs, Gebäude 1, Raum 1414 (CREALAB), Werdenbergstrasse 4
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (ICE Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.blurb: The Rhine valley edition of OST’s monthly AI round table: an informal evening in the Buchs CREALAB where university experts talk through how the technology actually works and how to point it at a problem you already have.

events.title: Azure Zurich User Group X-Mas Special 2026
events.blurb: The Azure Zürich User Group closes the year with its Christmas get-together at Frau Gerolds Wintergarten — no agenda, just food, glühwein and the Swiss Azure community. Places are limited.

events.title: KubeVirt in Practice & AI in QA: What Works, What Doesn't
events.blurb: Two talks in Zurich: Red Hat's Simon Krenger on running virtual machines next to containers with KubeVirt, including live demos and when it is the wrong tool, and Basia Karaagac on where AI genuinely helps in QA and where exploratory testing and human risk judgement still win.

events.title: Fabric Year in Review 2026 — Highlights & Outlook
events.organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
events.blurb: Year-end session from the Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on what actually shipped in Fabric during 2026 and what is worth planning for next.

events.title: AI-Lunch Basel: Brown Bag
events.blurb: Deliberately low-key lunch break for Basel's AI crowd: no slides and no preparation, just an open exchange of learnings and use cases across industries.

events.title: Robots, Agents and the Future of Work
events.venue: Université de Fribourg, Campus de Pérolles, PER 21, Boulevard de Pérolles 90
events.blurb: A panel with Peter Fankhauser (co-founder and CEO of ANYbotics) and Anne Scherer (co-founder of Delta Labs) on how AI is changing company operations, from autonomous robots on the plant floor to generative AI in the boardroom.

events.title: AI-Powered SDLC: Zurich Tech Leaders Evening
events.blurb: Four practitioner talks for CTOs and engineering leaders on AI in software delivery: a year of lessons from building with AI, securing the software lifecycle against prompt injection and compromised agents, making enterprise data ready for AI agents, and AI-assisted delivery inside regulated healthcare.

events.title: The Night of Data Talents: Startup Edition
events.blurb: Swiss data startups pitch to an investor panel with community voting, capping the year for the Suisse Romande data scene.

events.title: Swiss Viz Awards 2026 — Award Ceremony
events.venue: HSLU Design Film Kunst, Project Space Building 745, Nylsuisseplatz 1
events.organiser: Swiss Viz Awards (Interactive Things) with Data Visualization Zurich
events.blurb: The Swiss Viz Awards ceremony at the Lucerne School of Design, Film and Art: a keynote from data-visualisation designer Moritz Stefaner, the awards themselves with entrants and jury in the room, then an apéro — joined by the Data Visualization Zurich community as a field trip.

events.title: AI Futures: Navigating the Future
events.venue: ETH Zurich Main Building, Rämistrasse 101, Room F 26.5
events.blurb: Closing session of the AI Futures series, moving from grand plans to personal ones: how people actually get into AI safety work, what to do about personal finances under uncertainty, and how to handle information overload and keep your footing.

events.title: From Parallel Token Prediction to Scalable Language Models
events.venue: ETH AI Center Foyer, OAT X 11, Andreasstrasse 5, Oerlikon
events.blurb: Prof. Stephan Mandt (UC Irvine) on generating several mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass — models pretrained to 3 billion parameters that approach autoregressive quality with inference up to 5.7× faster. Hosted by Prof. Julia Vogt.

events.title: Data Fairness Community — December 2026
events.cost: For Swiss Insights corporate members (registration required)
events.blurb: Data-ethics community meeting at the UZH Digital Society Initiative: data-quality lessons from the City of Zurich's MeLODy chatbot and the Federal Statistical Office, a study on human-AI teaming in marketing, and the “AI Encyclical” dialogue format, followed by an apéro.

events.title: AI for Business: Network, Learn & Grow in Zurich
events.venue: ibis Styles Zurich City Center, Stampfenbachstrasse 60
events.cost: Ticket required via Eventfrog (some early-bird tickets free; drinks not included)
events.blurb: December edition of the small-room series where founders and executives compare how they actually use AI: an invited talk, group conversations on what worked and what failed, then open networking.

events.title: Davos Catalyst: AI Summit 2027
events.venue: Davos Event Lounge, Rätia Center, Promenade 40
events.cost: CHF 7,900 delegate pass (CHF 5,900 until 31 October, excl. VAT)
events.blurb: Invitation-only summit running alongside Davos week for around 200 founders, investors, corporate leaders and researchers, with roundtables and closed-door sessions on AI infrastructure, investment, enterprise deployment and governance.

events.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära
events.venue: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus Rapperswil, Raum 1.213
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.cost: CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included)
events.blurb: One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants.

events.title: AI House Davos 2027
events.blurb: Five days of AI programming on the Davos Promenade alongside the World Economic Forum, bringing research, industry, policy and civil society together under the 2027 theme "Citizens of an expanding world".

events.title: AI-Stammtisch Basel: Input und Diskussion am Abend
events.venue: iRIX Software Engineering AG, Gundeldinger Feld, Bau 5, Dornacherstrasse 192
events.blurb: The Basel AI Stammtisch returns for the new year with a guest talk or an in-house topic, followed by open discussion over drinks at the iRIX bistro.

events.title: digitalswitzerland @ Davos
events.blurb: A full day in Davos on Switzerland's digital future, with speakers from business, government and research building on the national AI Action Plan and looking ahead to the Geneva AI Summit 2027. Programme details still to be published.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — Generating Survey Questions with LLMs
events.blurb: Anna Fuchs (Social Data Science and AI Lab, LMU Munich) presents a study that benchmarked five large language models and three prompting techniques against the Survey Quality Predictor, and what it says about where LLM-written items still fall short.

events.title: Digital Lounge @ Davos — Enterprise Data, AI & Robotics
events.blurb: An invitation-only forum during Davos week for CxOs and transformation leaders on enterprise data, AI and robotics — morning and afternoon keynotes and panels, a live technology showcase, entrepreneur talks and parallel workshops, closing with an awards ceremony and dinner.

events.title: Generative AI for Epidemiology Researchers: Practical Skills and Responsible Use
events.blurb: A three-day course in Wengen on using generative AI responsibly in research, pairing lectures with computer practicals on analysis, literature searching, scientific writing, study websites and agentic AI — and on where error, bias and reproducibility break down.

events.title: AI for Decision Makers — Executive Course at ETH Zurich
events.time: 09:00–17:00 on 22, 28 and 29 January and 4 and 5 February
events.organiser: Swiss Data Science Center / ETH Zürich School for Continuing Education
events.cost: CHF 4,000 (10% off for ETH staff and alumni and SDSC partners)
events.blurb: A five-day English-language executive course for leaders who need to challenge assumptions on AI projects without becoming data scientists — data science foundations, MLOps, AI governance and ethics, generative AI and a first agent, with an ETH Zurich certificate. Registration closes 15 January 2027.

events.title: Generative AI & Agentische Systeme
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.blurb: Two-day German-language course for developers, architects, data scientists and ML engineers on building agentic LLM systems that survive production: function calling, hybrid-search RAG, LangGraph topologies, security hardening and systematic evaluation. Places are limited.

events.title: SWAT4HCLS 2027
events.blurb: The 15th edition of the long-running international conference on semantics in healthcare and life sciences — ontologies, knowledge graphs and AI — with keynotes, tutorials and a dedicated biohackathon day in Basel.

events.title: SDSC-Connect: Connecting Digital Environmental Sciences
events.venue: Central Bern venue to be announced
events.blurb: A day in Bern on making environmental data usable across disciplines and institutions — data access and sharing, data infrastructure, and the role of machine learning and AI across climate, ecology, hydrology, the cryosphere, natural hazards and agriculture, with keynotes, invited talks, break-outs and a poster fair. Seats are limited and the venue is still to be announced.

events.title: AI & Quantum Course: From Foundations to Scalable Intelligence
events.blurb: An afternoon course run with Quantum Basel, led by its CTO Jan Mikolon, bridging current AI practice and quantum technologies — from the foundations through to what it takes to scale.

events.title: Hack Apertus — Midway
events.venue: Novu Campus @ The Circle, The Circle 60
events.blurb: The mid-series afternoon of the national Hack Apertus initiative: Imanol Schlag (ETH), Thomas Taroni (Phoeniqs) and David Gugelmann (Exeon Analytics) on the model, the infrastructure and the security, three hackathon projects showing what they built, then parallel Q&A tables and a closing reception.

events.title: Kickstart AI Workflows with Databricks
events.organiser: Swiss Data & AI Group (Databricks User Group)
events.blurb: Hybrid Databricks user-group evening in Zurich on automating data work with AI-enabled workflows, including a session on Databricks Apps and Lakebase applied to clinical cancer research cohorts. Rescheduled from November 2026 to February 2027.

events.title: KI-Meetup Graubünden Nr. 10 — Voice AI
events.organiser: Markenkern AG and Code Crush GmbH, powered by GRdigital
events.blurb: Tenth edition of the Graubünden AI meetup in Chur, with Rico Castelberg on voice AI and digital telephone assistants, followed by open discussion and networking.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Geneva
events.blurb: Geneva leg of the fifth AI Days, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, with workshops, talks, research and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Yverdon-les-Bains
events.blurb: Yverdon-les-Bains leg of AI Days 2027, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, with workshops, talks and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: AI Days 2027 — Fribourg
events.blurb: Fribourg leg of AI Days 2027, the Swiss AI Center’s applied-AI conference for SMEs, closing the three-city edition with workshops, talks and demos. Registration not yet open.

events.title: GenAI Zürich 2027
events.blurb: A two-day European summit on applied generative AI at the Volkshaus: keynotes, panels, workshops, roundtables, a hackathon, startup pitches and the GenAI Zürich Award, focused on what works in production.

events.title: IMD KI-Update 2027
events.organiser: echo originals AG (with IMD as knowledge partner)
events.cost: CHF 890 (early bird CHF 712 until 15 November 2026; CHF 623 per person for teams of five or more)
events.blurb: A one-day German-language management congress on leading in the AI era: executive cases, keynotes on efficiency, growth, trust and responsibility, and a closing keynote by Richard David Precht.

events.title: Swiss Insights TRAINING — KI in der betrieblichen Marktforschung
events.cost: CHF 80 for Swiss Insights individual members, CHF 120 for non-members (excl. VAT)
events.blurb: German-language webinar with Karin Hagemann (S-Communication Services) on putting generative AI and agentic workflows to work in in-house research teams, including building small tools yourself and where the limits sit.

events.title: Swiss Legal Tech Conference 2027
events.blurb: A day of sessions on legal technology and AI in practice: comprehensive data management and whether data lakes break down silos, risk and exit management for legal tech, courts in the age of AI, and what role AI agents play today.

events.title: Voxxed Days Zürich 2027
events.cost: CHF 301 early bird, CHF 360 standard, CHF 166 student
events.blurb: One-day developer conference at the Sihlcity cinemas with nine tracks, among them agentic engineering and tooling (agents, RAG, evals, LLMOps) and a cloud native, data and infrastructure track covering streaming, vector databases and model serving.

events.title: Software Engineering in der Vibe-Code-Ära
events.venue: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Campus St. Gallen, Raum FZ.0211
events.organiser: OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Institut für Computational Engineering)
events.cost: CHF 600 (materials, refreshments and a follow-up online clinic included)
events.blurb: One-day German-language course for senior engineers, tech leads and CTOs who already code with agentic tools: build your own eval suite, an MCP tool wired to your build and test commands, a CI hook that blocks bad AI patches, and a cost-per-feature model comparison — working on your own repository. Limited to 16 participants.
